parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for all distinct compounds tested against the target CHEMBL261. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Return columns aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
